LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_HullInspect: The hull of a destroyed vehicle. Taken apart, it gives {COUNT} salvaged vehicle parts.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_HullInspectBurnt: The burnt-out hull of a vehicle that died in a fire: its rubber, wiring and seals are gone. Taken apart, it gives {COUNT} salvaged vehicle parts, half what it would have.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_LostConvoyInspect: {COUNT} vehicles stand here where the convoy stopped, with {PEOPLE} others aboard and all their cargo.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_LostConvoyLeft: The convoy's {COUNT} vehicles stand where it stopped, with their cargo. Send a caravan to bring them home.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingHullsStayDes: A vehicle destroyed on a map, yours or anyone's, leaves its hull where it fell. Taken apart, a hull gives salvaged vehicle parts, worth a quarter of the vehicle, which pay for a part fitted at the salvaged grade. A raiders' aircraft brought down still leaves nothing.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingLostConvoysS: Lost convoys stay where they stopped

When the last colonist of a convoy dies on the road, its vehicles, their cargo and anyone else aboard stay on the world map where it stopped, for a caravan to come back for. Off, they are lost with the convoy, as before.
